KaTeX 0.19.1 — local math rendering for the reading list.
Upstream: https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX
Release: https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX/releases/download/v0.19.1/katex.tar.gz
Documentation: https://katex.org/docs/browser
Included: minified browser renderer, auto-render extension, stylesheet, fonts,
and LICENSE. No runtime CDN request is required.
